units.source_text: 不過，比目魚為什麼非要拐彎抹角地使出這些花招呢？

en.t: But why did Flounder have to go through all these roundabout tricks?

units.source_text: 我對此似懂非懂，覺得很是奇怪）。

en.t: I half understood and half did not, and it struck me as very strange).

units.source_text: 我用這筆錢，一個人去了趟南伊豆溫泉，

en.t: With that money, I went alone to the hot springs of South Izu,

units.source_text: 但我不是那種悠然享受溫泉之旅的人，

en.t: but I was not the sort of person who could leisurely enjoy a hot spring trip,

units.source_text: 旅途中一想到良子，便感到寂寞難耐，

en.t: and whenever I thought of Yoshiko on the trip, the loneliness became unbearable,

units.source_text: 根本不能以平靜的心情，透過旅館的窗戶，眺望逶迤的遠山。

en.t: and I was in no state of mind to calmly gaze through the inn window at the distant rolling mountains.

units.source_text: 在房間裡，我既沒有換上旅館的棉和服，也沒去池子泡溫泉，

en.t: In my room, I neither changed into the inn's padded cotton robe nor went to soak in the bath,

units.source_text: 而是跑到旅館外，跑進一家髒兮兮的茶館，

en.t: but instead ran outside the inn and rushed into a filthy little teahouse,

units.source_text: 猛喝燒酒，讓身體變得更加虛弱，然後返回了東京。

en.t: drank shochu recklessly, weakened my body even further, and then returned to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 那是東京大雪紛飛的一個夜晚。

en.t: It was a night when heavy snow was falling over Tokyo.
